overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance metrics highlights that content framed around extreme space scenarios, speculative 'What If' planetary exploration, and cosmic curiosities achieve significantly higher engagement velocity (views-per-day and like-to-view ratios) than standard anatomical or psychological facts. In particular, titles involving extreme hypothetical planetary environments (e.g., liquid diamond, burning ice, nonillion-dollar diamond planets) drive superior audience retention and engagement compared to older historical or psychological micro-stories.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) lead in views and engagement metrics over the recent 7-day period.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on high-stakes, visually striking planetary survival and exploration scenarios that trigger immediate curiosity and immersive world-building.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos covering bizarre space facts such as Venus having a day longer than its year (A9Qa-RmuOr0) and planetary rain phenomena (QXuqYERlqSo, v1rrcZLdp4U) exhibit strong organic traction and consistent view accumulation.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form concepts focusing on extreme, counter-intuitive physical properties of celestial bodies with vivid visual metaphors.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics centered around memory creation, songs stuck in the head, and basic human psychology (e.g., ef3ND4qiRHc, 5AN7LUgqarc, mGEgENcGcNE) underperform in total views and velocity relative to cosmic content.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard psychological tricks and redirect production resources toward cinematic space and high-concept physical sciences.

weak_patterns.pattern: Static Zoological Trivia Without High-Stakes Framing
weak_patterns.evidence: Simple biological facts like octopus hearts or immortal jellyfish (AXAfwrzzEdU, F1kXwuXuNgo) show flat growth curves and minimal community engagement compared to planetary 'What If' scenarios.
weak_patterns.action: If producing animal content, pivot exclusively toward cinematic animal survival or extreme prehistoric context rather than simple static trivia.
